set-stickers.desc: You can't buy these on their own. These stickers only come free with a SKOCKZ matched set. Pick them when you add a set to your cart.

skockz-sets-all-four-1-of-1.desc: All four sets. One buyer. This listing only exists while every one of them is still here. GOBLIN, GALAH, BLUEBOTTLE and REDBACK are four 1-of-1 SKOCKSTERS, each sold with the worry stone made to match it. Three of them also come with a two-sided SKO/CKZ logo keychain in the same colours, and every set comes with 3 stickers you pick. Green, pink, blue and red, all shaped by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts.

skockz-set-05-redback-1-of-1.desc: Set 05. A SKOCKSTER, the worry stone made to match it and a logo keychain, all in the same reds, plus three stickers you pick, sold together. There is exactly one of it and this page is it. REDBACK is the red one, named after the spider every Aussie kid gets told to check the shed for. It has a glossy red body, a crimson star visor pulled low across the eyes and a gold nose.

skockz-set-04-bluebottle-1-of-1.desc: Set 04. A SKOCKSTER, the worry stone made to match it and a logo keychain, all in the same blues, plus three stickers you pick, sold together. There is exactly one of it and this page is it. BLUEBOTTLE is the blue one, named after the jellyfish that washes up on every Aussie beach come summer. It has a glossy cobalt body, a wide black star visor pulled low across the eyes, a pale-blue nose and a single white fang.

skockz-set-03-galah-1-of-1.desc: Set 03. A SKOCKSTER, the worry stone made to match it and a logo keychain, all in the same pinks, plus three stickers you pick, sold together. It's the first set with more than two pieces. There is exactly one of it and this page is it. GALAH is the pink one, named after the pink cockatoo.

skockz-set-02-goblin-1-of-1.desc: Set 02. One SKOCKSTER and the worry stone made to match it, plus 3 stickers you pick, sold together. There is exactly one of this set and this page is it. GOBLIN is the green one. A glitter-olive body, a bright green star visor pulled low across the eyes, two curved green horns, a green nose, a single white fang and a round lime core, with green arms and four green studs lined up across its feet. Three greens on one piece.

skockz-set-01-nugget-1-of-1.desc: Set 01. One SKOCKSTER and the worry stone made to match it, sold together. There is exactly one of this set and this page is it. NUGGET is the gold one. A gold body and round gold core, a slate-grey star visor pulled low across the eyes, a copper nose, two round copper ears, and copper-shimmer arms and claws.

skockz-case-003-narwhal-1-of-1.desc: Serial C03/001. One case, one photo, one owner. NARWHAL is a pale ocean-blue clay body under a heavy navy brow, with one blue horn on top, big white eyes glancing sideways, two black nostrils and the biggest pout in the crew. Wrapped, shaped and worked around the lighter body by hand in Warrnambool, then sealed under a UV resin glaze. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

skockster-015-crush-1-of-1.desc: Serial 015/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. CRUSH is the all-pink one — the first SKOCKSTER built entirely in SKOCKZ pink. A hot-pink body, a coral star visor with a pearl shimmer pulled low across the eyes, coral horns, a dusty-pink snout and a single white fang, with salmon-pink arms, a round magenta core and shimmer-coral studs lined up across its feet.

skockster-014-alloy-1-of-1.desc: Serial 014/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. ALLOY is the all-metal one — four metallic clays mixed on a single piece. A copper body, a bronze star visor pulled low across the eyes, bronze arms, a round gold core, and gunmetal horns, snout and claws. A single cream fang is the only part that isn't metal. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts.

skockster-013-thrash-1-of-1.desc: Serial 013/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. THRASH rides its own board. A two-tone red body, a black star visor pulled low across the eyes, silver horns, a silver nose and a single white fang, with raspberry-pink arms and a round red core. It stands on a red deck with four pink wheels, silver studs lined up across its feet. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool.

skockster-010-mirage-1-of-1.desc: Serial 010/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. MIRAGE is a hand-sculpted dragon in four greens — a lime body, a teal star visor pulled low across the eyes, round bright-green ears and nose, teal arms and a teal tail fin, lime feet studded with green toe beads, a pale mint core and a single cream fang. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts.

skockster-012-patina-1-of-1.desc: Serial 012/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. PATINA is named for the green that copper turns as it ages — and it wears both. A mint-green body, a wide black visor pulled low across the eyes, round copper ears, a copper nose, copper talons, and a row of copper plates running down its spine into the tail. A deep teal core and a single cream fang finish it.

skockz-skateboarding-socks-limited-editi.desc: ON SALE NOW — SOCKS ONLY, $15. All 100 pairs are here in Warrnambool. Only 40 are going out without a can, and this is them. The $25 collectible can option follows in a few days, once every can has been numbered by hand. Designed in Warrnambool · Made to Shred. The first SKOCKZ sock run — 100 pairs, one colourway, one size. Black and charcoal grey, ribbed leg, contrast cuff, heel and toe, with the SKOCKSTER up the side.

mini-skocksters-keychain.desc: Yours is the only one. There will never be another. Every Mini SKOCKSTER is rolled, shaped and assembled by hand from polymer clay — no moulds, no casts, no production line. Two identical ones have never come off the desk, and never will. Yours doesn't exist yet. It gets made after you order, in the colour and ear shape you pick, then clipped to its keyring and sent from Warrnambool. 1 of 1 — always.

skockz-signature-hoodie.desc: PRE-ORDER — SHIPS FROM NOVEMBER 2026. This hoodie is made in one small batch, not held in stock. Order now and yours is reserved from that run. You'll get an email at every step, and a full refund on request any time before it ships. Free pickup in Warrnambool once it lands. Size guide & how to measure → The pocket is a skateboard. An actual one. Most hoodies give you one kangaroo pouch and call it a day.

clay-skockz-logo.desc: The SKOCKZ logo. In clay. On your keys. Hand-assembled polymer clay keychain featuring the iconic SKOCKZ aesthetic. Choose between the bold SZ monogram or the full SKOCKZ logo with ears — both available in any colour to match your vibe. Add an optional UV resin glaze for extra protection and shine, or take it raw. A compact statement for skaters who carry the brand everywhere. Made in Warrnambool.
